prompt: A town has $1250$ people and its population DOUBLES every $10$ years. After how many years does the town reach $10000$ people?
hint: Divide the target by the start to see how much growth is needed.

hints.text: Divide the target by the start to see how much growth is needed.

hints.title: 🪜 Try a simpler one
hints.text: Warm up: going from $100$ to $400$ is $\times 4$, and $4 = 2^2$, so $2$ doublings. Same move — divide, then count doublings.

alternativeExplanations.title: Count decade by decade
steps: The town hits $10{,}000$ people at year $30$.
